cannedResponses.title: Late check-in
cannedResponses.text: Late check-in is available. Please send us your expected arrival time and we will confirm the access instructions.

cannedResponses.title: Transfer request
cannedResponses.text: We can help arrange a transfer. Please send your arrival location, time, number of guests and luggage details.

cannedResponses.title: Direct booking enquiry
cannedResponses.text: Thank you for your enquiry. Please send your preferred dates and number of guests and we will confirm the best available direct option.

cannedResponses.title: Late checkout
cannedResponses.text: Late checkout may be available subject to occupancy. We will confirm availability and any applicable supplement.

cannedResponses.title: Post-stay review
cannedResponses.text: Thank you for staying with us. We hope you enjoyed your visit. If you have a moment, we would really appreciate your feedback.
